truth_record.title: Resource-case wrapper casts negative mode values to huge unsigned allocation sizes
truth_record.notes: mode is a signed public API parameter; mode=-2 wraps to UINT32_MAX after mode+1, causing area+1 to wrap in the downstream allocation path before pid_list[0] is written.

#define SAFE_FREE(ptr)       do { if (ptr) { free(ptr); (ptr) = NULL; } } while(0)
#define ARRAY_SIZE(arr)      (sizeof(arr) / sizeof((arr)[0]))

threat_assumptions: Only behavior supported by the supplied code and contract evidence may be treated as concrete.
External API semantics, attacker control, deployment concurrency, and callback behavior require explicit evidence and must not be assumed from the truth title.
Attacker controllability requires a structured source or public caller contract; a dangerous sink alone is insufficient.
